description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
summary: Paperclip is a Node.js server and React dashboard that sits on top of whatever agent CLIs you already run—Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI—and gives you a single place to assign goals, watch progress, and enforce per-agent budgets. It scratches the same itch PenguPool does but from the other end: instead of routing sessions inside VS Code, it's the outer coordination layer for when you've got more than one agent working in parallel and you're losing track of who's doing what. The adapter model is clean (any CLI that can receive a heartbeat plugs in), and the cost-tracking-per-agent piece is the part I'd actually wire into my own workflow.
